text: Foundation F1-F5 (foundation.md D1-D6) built in this epic first: the any-mcp orchestrator plugin, the wrapper notes inbox and main-agent gate, ClusterSpec max_replicas and static with render gating and pins, the agent API with its port, token and pod-IP identity, and migration 0003.
